solutions.title: Stack terms
solutions.strategy: Push signed addition/subtraction terms and immediately fold multiplication or division into the top term.

timeComplexity.explanation: The expression string is scanned once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack can store one term for each additive segment.

solutions.title: Rolling last term
solutions.strategy: Keep a running total excluding the current multiplicative term, and update the last term by operator precedence.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current number, last term, and total are stored.
